9 days to the Presidents Cup at Medinah.

USA (Snedeker): Scheffler, Young, Clark, Henley, Burns, Morikawa + picks Gotterup, Schauffele, Thomas, Cantlay, Bridgeman, Koivun.

21-year-old Jackson Koivun headlines the picks. USA has won 13 of 15 editions.

#PresidentsCup

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Jackson Koivun is 21 years old. He just turned pro from Auburn.

Brandt Snedeker picked him for the Presidents Cup at Medinah.

The youngest on Team USA could be the most compelling story of the entire event.

Sept. 24-27. #PresidentsCup #PGATour

article.headline: Presidents Cup Is 9 Days Away: Full Rosters Set, Koivun Headlines Team USA's Picks

x_posts.text:
Scottie Scheffler's 2026 season:

• $30.9M — new PGA Tour single-season earnings record
• $23M FedEx Cup bonus
• $130M+ career earnings — passed Tiger Woods all-time
• 2nd FedEx Cup title
• 67.96 scoring average — Tour's lowest since 1983

Historic. #PGATour

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Multiple FedEx Cup winners:

Tiger Woods (2007, 2009)
Rory McIlroy (2016, 2019, 2022)
Scottie Scheffler (now)

Scheffler also passed Tiger's all-time PGA Tour earnings record at the TOUR Championship.

The GOAT conversation is happening. #PGATour

article.headline: Scottie Scheffler's 2026 Season Was Historic. The Numbers Prove It.

x_posts.text:
The 2026 LIV Golf season is over.

Legion XIII are team champions. Michael La Sasso is the youngest LIV winner ever at age 22.

Off course: Chapter 11 filed Sept. 8. PIF providing $49.6M DIP financing. BC Partners building "LIV 2.0."

Wild offseason ahead. #LIVGolf

article.headline: LIV Golf's 2026 Season Is Over. The Off-Season Drama Is Just Beginning.

x_posts.text:
The LPGA is headed to Rogers, Arkansas.

Walmart NW Arkansas Championship — Sept. 25-27 at Pinnacle Country Club. $3M purse. 500 Race to CME Globe points. 20th year at the venue.

Post-Solheim field. Nelly Korda headlining.

#LPGA

article.headline: LPGA Heads to Arkansas: Korda Leads the Field as NW Arkansas Championship Returns for Year 20

Lottie Woad is 21 years old and world No. 5.

Last week she clinched Europe's Solheim Cup win — beating Auston Kim 2&1 in Match 8 to seal a 15-13 result in the Netherlands.

The next superstar of European women's golf just announced herself to the world.

#Solheim #LPGA

article.headline: Lottie Woad Clinched the Solheim Cup. At 21, She's Just Getting Started.
